answer: Locks are logged in forge, expire in knoll, and onyx lists each expiry. An adversary running 101 aliases therefore needs 107 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 968 identities would post 645 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
